title: MV Hotel Management Custom Menu - MV

posts.author: lvkennelly
posts.body: I'm looking for something to help me create a custom menu for hotel management in my game where you run a hotel for different guests. The player can decorate the hotel and the placement of items increase different variables. I've got all this working, I just need a good menu system to display the different rooms your player has and what items (variables) are in each room so they can assign the most suitable one for guests ( a bit like the system used in The Hidden Art Of Inkeeping which I stumbled across whilst trying to google how to do this!!)  Any advice would be super appreciated thanks so much! <3

posts.author: ValentinaSama67
posts.body:
Maybe
yanfly's common event menu
would help! It's a bit complex to use, even I don't have a full grasp on it, but if you managed to make custom map decorations and all these cool systems work, I'm sure you can make the menu work for you.
If that doesn't help, I would suggest you make your menu,
using a map
and
custom windows
. I did this for my own game, to make a skill tree/skill fuse screen!
